name: RichaadEB Touhou Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

The mod adds in RichaadEB’s Touhou Songs all of them so far released that is, to SPT. as he releases more music I’ll add more in as needed but that won’t require any updates. same with all my Music mods.

Submod to Bobby’s Main menu Music Mod possible in raid version may come upon request of whenever up to it.

Install: Drag BepinEx folder into SPT directory.
